newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Win Win changes name to PCL Enterprises.
newsitem.headline: Win Win changes name to PCL Enterprises.

text.p: Win Win International Holdings Ltd said on Monday it has changed its company name to PCL Enterprises Holdings Ltd with immediate effect.
The company said its shareholders had approved the proposal to change the company name in a special general meeting held on December 2.
In October, the textile machinery distributor proposed a change in name to render the company a new image following a change in management and a business restructuring.
